key_insight: SwarmLink adds peer-to-peer coordination so multiple UAVs can reassign inspection targets on the fly, making photovoltaic sensing missions more resilient to failures and low-quality captures.
engineering_relevance: For solar plant inspection, the system reduces dependence on a single ground station by enabling distributed runtime task allocation without changing the host UAV framework.
method: Non-invasively extends Aerostack2 with inter-agent communication for coordination.
Uses a distributed auction to assign initial targets and re-auction remaining targets after failures or bad data.
Unifies normal allocation, platform-failure recovery, and data-quality-triggered reassignment into one mechanism.
evidence_signal: The abstract presents a photovoltaic plant inspection case study demonstrating the approach conceptually across three disruption scenarios, but it does not report quantitative results.
watch_item: Performance and robustness will depend on reliable inter-UAV communication and the overhead of repeated re-auctions in real missions.
paper_title: Distributed Coordination for Resilient Multi-UAV Remote Sensing: A Photovoltaic Inspection Case Study
